about: The identifiers Classic Cart Studio files and programs use to say which game system, core, console model, console software, installation method, storage layout, controller, boot option, save format, driver and capability something is for. Each axis is independent: a console model is not its software, its software is not a game system, and a game system is not a core. status 'supported' means this version may use the entry (every other check, gate and approval still applies); status 'reserved' means the name exists so files and code can refer to it, and it is denied everywhere: in the website and the Windows app, in the shared engine, in the workers and before any console program. Nothing read from a file, a URL, a request or a setting can change an entry's status; only a reviewed release can. GPL-3.0-or-later.

entries.reason: No core is selected, licensed, built or qualified for this system.
A placeholder for a core that has not been chosen. Nothing is bundled for it.

entries.note: The Super NES Classic Edition of North America and Europe (board dp-shvc with REGION USA or EUR; the Super Famicom Classic Mini, REGION JPN, is not this model). The console hardware only: its games still need a core this version does not have. Each operation it allows is listed as its own capability.
The console's own software, as Nintendo shipped it or with hakchi added.

The console's own software on Super NES Classic hardware, as Nintendo shipped it or with hakchi added. A copy of it is a console software environment, never a Classic Cart Studio core, on any hardware.
Classic Cart Studio HOME started by the console's startup under the pinned hakchi (the current installation).

536,870,912 bytes of NAND (the console's own nandinfo reads 2048 64 4096); five parts, its data storage an ext4 file system named data. The table each console reports is checked against its running system before anything is read.

entries.reason: A name kept for files that referred to it; the supported layout is snes-classic-nand-512m.
Never shown or installed: there is no supported provider and no verified payload.

entries.note: cart.sav: the core's battery memory, exact bytes, no header.
Inspection, and conversion only for the exact games and sizes this version recognizes.

entries.reason: Its files are kept and exported as they are; nothing converts them.

entries.note: Reading the console's identity, startup software and storage table, and the check-up (Console Browser), read only.
Opening, checking, exporting from and repairing a backup file of this console on the PC; no console is needed.

Expert Mode's and Developer Mode's file changes on its data storage, and the Sega Mini menu pictures clean-up: the same scopes as the NES Classic's (its HOME saves and settings in clover/profiles, games added with hakchi in hakchi/games, Classic Cart Studio's own data). Its saves are written exactly as chosen; nothing converts them.

Console Composer and private restore packages: files move only between consoles of this model, and from one console to another only when both are of the same region (their built-in games and hakchi's game folders differ by region).

CCS Mod (CCS HOME and its tile in the console's own menu), CCS Nucleus (what opens at power-on; its native choice is the console's own Super NES menu) and HOME designs, through hakchi's own package folder and its game folders for this model (games/snes-usa or games/snes-eur, the built-in /usr/share/games).
An owner's own system image (a Nintendo Classic system's root, .hsqs) as a CCS Nucleus choice: a selectable system started with hakchi's kernel, never this console's bootloader, kernel or identity.
Community mods through hakchi's own package folder: only packages whose catalog record lists this model (and its region); the catalog itself lists only what authors approved.
